facts.fact: Sonatel (Orange Group) states the 2Africa submarine cable was commissioned in December 2025 at the Senegal landing station, which Sonatel owns and operates.

The article says 2Africa is run on an Open Access basis ensuring non-discriminatory use of capacity, with carrier-neutral landing stations available to all operators, the Senegal station being Sonatel's; dated by the article's publication, 2026-02-23.

systems.owner: Consortium; Senegal landing station owned by Sonatel
